comment: ADR-55/ADR-56 engine sources: the two repositories AISLE builds wheels from. kiss3d is absent on purpose, and so are the rapier crates the engine links: nexus's own Cargo manifest patches those from git by rev, so cargo resolves them and this file does not pin them twice.

nexus.builds: the nexus3d wheel (the GPU engine and its viewer)

rapier.builds: the rapier3d wheel (python/rapier-py-3d), the CPU engine's bindings
